name: Torch
effect: Illuminates caves — radius 1, lasts until you exit the dungeon

name: Fairy Water
effect: Repels weaker monsters for 128 steps on the overworld
note: Identical effect to the REPEL spell

name: Wings
effect: Instantly returns hero to Tantegel Castle from anywhere on the overworld
note: Same effect as RETURN spell. Consumed on use.

name: Magic Key
effect: Opens a locked door. Consumed on use.
note: Price varies by shop. Rimuldar is cheapest (53G).

name: Dragon's Scale
effect: Raises hero Defense Power by 2 when equipped
note: Does not count as armor — stacks with armor/shield

name: Fighter's Ring
effect: Does nothing (appears useful but has no effect — cursed item)

name: Cursed Belt
effect: Places a curse on the hero when equipped. Harmful — do not use.
found_in: Garin's Grave B3 and Charlock Castle B8

name: Cursed Necklace
effect: Places a curse on the hero when equipped. Harmful — do not use.
found_in: Mountain Cave B2 (1/32 chance from gold chest)
note: Can only be obtained once. Death Necklace in JP version.
